hero.description: Based in Castro Urdiales, Spain, I'm a Software Developer Analyst. I love to work with enterprise applications, REST APIs, and cloud technologies. I'm passionate about full-stack development, performance optimization, and building robust software.

about.title: ABOUT
about.text: Software Developer Analyst with over 6 years of experience in full-stack development (Java, Spring Boot, Oracle, TypeScript, Angular). Throughout my career, I've held positions in renowned tech companies across Spain. My contributions have been pivotal in modernizing enterprise applications, implementing REST APIs with Spring Boot, and engaging in full-stack development. My passion for continuous learning and innovation is evident through my active presence on various platforms. I thrive on staying updated with the latest trends and technologies in the ever-evolving tech landscape. I bring a unique blend of technical expertise, leadership qualities, and a genuine enthusiasm for creating impactful software solutions.

jobs.description: Modernization of the billing and toll management module for Gipuzkoa. Machine configuration, build management with Maven and Jenkins, and application deployment across environments. Development and optimization of REST APIs with Spring Boot.
Development and maintenance of the Gipuzkoa toll management application. Implementation of features with Java, Spring Boot, Jooq and Oracle on backend. Frontend development with Angular.
Analysis, design and development of applications for the Community of Madrid with Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Oracle and PL/SQL. Web application development with Angular and JSF.
Web application maintenance and improvement (PHP and MySQL). Development of automated signage generation app for Eroski (.NET, Oracle, PL/SQL). Web portals for Diputación Foral de Gipuzkoa.
Development and maintenance of educational web applications (Java, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap). Moodle platform management and support for schools in Vizcaya.
